entry_points.text: Processor online, dead and pre removal callbacks adapt the instance linked from the notification node; activation and termination recompute distribution while preparation clears affiliation, each reporting success.

Device exposes count, channel, per queue moderation and hash size operations; counts learn geometry from an empty context, channels derive combined width, per queue validates index against maximum pairs, and hash sizes return stored key and table extents.

exports.text: Ethtool groups steering, moderation, queues and link with frame count, delay and adaptive flags, plus handlers for steering, moderation, rings, channels, link, info, strings and counters. Queue statistics adds receive, transmit and base paths fetching by slot with receive even. Steering preserves or selects Toeplitz with table needing scaling and key needing scaling or hash reporting, notifying only when accepted; base totals start at zero with extended fields gated.

hazards.text: Allocation failure abandons affinity distribution and runs cleanup without marking hints; callers must not assume hints exist. Pairs resize sequentially with early exit, so failure can leave mixed depths; the transition is not atomic.

Allocation failures return out of memory; moderation failures return invalid leaving cached values unchanged. Fetch transport failure propagates except in ethtool collection where it warns and continues with driver counters.

Transmit cache updates lack the per queue mutex used for receive, relying on benign races or external serialization. Deferred work revalidates enable state under the mutex preventing stale programming.

Transmit completion distinguishes socket buffers including orphaned variants, packet framework frames and zero copy completions by a tag; each needs its own release and conflating them corrupts accounting or stalls completion.

Enable validates header room, page resources excluding large mode, queue range and DMA device equality and existence. Acquisition orders storage, header mapping, pool mapping then receive and transmit binding; failure unwinds in reverse including unbinding, unmapping and freeing.

invariants.text: Affinity spreads online processors across active pairs in balanced groups favoring early pairs; both directions share one group and completion records hints. Registration attaches online and dead handles without callbacks, undoing the first if the second fails; removal detaches both.

Channels accept only combined counts, rejecting split, zero, out of range or changes with packet programs attached; success updates queue count, refreshes affinity and publishes real counts. Rings report maxima from first descriptors and live depths; resize rejects mini and jumbo, treats unchanged as success, enforces maxima, resizes changed directions and reapplies moderation.

Per queue moderation submits identity with time and packet limits in device order; wrappers need the feature and cache limits on success. Without offload any delay is unsupported and only fixed depths are valid, else success without exchange. Transmit polling weight follows batch depth and may change only while link is down.

Default steering enables all hash kinds, derives a mask from table size with empty yielding zero, selects queue zero by default, refreshes distribution and installs fresh key material. Queries map transport over IP flows to address and transport selectors preferring combined coverage. Updates accept address pair, pair plus transport, or discard, clearing family bits, rejecting unsupported results and committing when active. Retrieval copies table with endian conversion and key bytes, reporting one function.

Statistics form a flat array of receive totals, transmit totals, control, then receive and transmit groups; width comes from per kind totals and names share the order. Shared totals sum over pairs. Placement honors selection and reply match. Pair is half the identifier and direction is parity; global spans twice current pairs and control derives from twice maximum. Driver groups always emit while hardware groups need capability, using plain and qualified names.

Link retrieval returns cached speed and duplex with generic port; initialization marks both unknown. Driver information reports module identity, version and bus name with generic fallback when the transport lacks a naming callback.

Guest offload set converts a mask to device order and issues control, reporting rejection. Mapping bypasses to physical address without the API, otherwise rejects virtual allocations and delegates with the queue device. Unmapping mirrors that selection with no operation on bypass.

Orphaned descriptors are reclaimed transmit then receive with scheduling cooperation via direction release. Minimum receive size accounts for headers plus the larger of MTU or architectural limit over capacity rounded up, clamped to header size and a packet floor. Transmit zero copy binding pauses, resets with transmit recycling, records the pool with failure forcing null, then resumes.

locks.text: Receive reprogramming during resize holds the per queue guard across the operation. Each receive mutex guards its adaptive flag and cached timing; deferred work rechecks the flag under it before programming.

Channel updates hold the processor set read guard across queue count change and affinity refresh on all paths. Suspend and resume serialize link changes with the global configuration lock, detach and attach with the transmit lock without bottom halves, and affinity programming under the CPU read lock.
Driver counters are sampled under sequence retry using per queue sync state; each snapshot begins a sequence, copies counters and repeats on concurrent modification.

state_machines.text: Adaptive moderation has disabled and enabled states globally and per queue. Enabling unchanged flips the flag without exchange; disabling flips then programs timing; enabling changed is invalid and without per queue support is unsupported. Deferred updates program only while enabled, otherwise resetting measurement.

Collection runs preparation, fetch, snapshot and aggregation. Preparation learns geometry; fetch is skipped without support else one batched request covers selected queues; snapshots follow per pair under protection; totals aggregation closes the sequence.

Suspend drains work, disables further work, closes an operational link, then detaches; resume rebuilds queues and resources, marks ready, reenables work, reopens when previously operational, then attaches, resetting and releasing on failure. Bringup programs affinity after successful discovery, releasing on failure. Teardown deletes poll contexts, waits a grace period and clears affinity before removal.

Setup dispatches to enable with a pool and disable without. Receive binding attaches metadata only when supplied, then pauses, resets with unmapping, records the pool and resumes; failure leaves null while always resuming. Disable validates range, unbinds both combining status, then releases DMA, mapping and storage.

Swap takes a reference, pauses reception and transmit polling when operational. Clearing removes references, restores offloads once and waits before resizing. Installing resizes first, publishes references, clears offloads once on transition from absent and marks redirect, clearing on removal. Attachment refuses oversized MTU, mergeable without single page headers, and offloads without control; excess demand warns and uses locked mode.

structs.text: Statistics context holds a destination selector, per category counts, type bitmaps, reply sizes and an output pointer across control, receive and transmit slots. Init starts from base counts then adds capability gated hardware groups; queue and legacy modes use different bases, legacy also accounting control.

Exchange uses requests with queue identifier plus type bitmap in device order, and a packed reply where each record carries length, identifier and kind plus payload; receivers advance by length. Mapping entries hold a source offset with sequential or explicit position; device sources read little endian and driver sources as protected counters.

Transport queues appear as repeating receive then transmit pairs with optional trailing control, distinct callbacks and names, receive signalling for mergeable or small modes, and control advertising virtual LAN filtering. Allocation creates control state when present plus paired arrays with poll contexts, scatter tables, estimator, statistics and per receive lock.

Coalescing uses a control class with per queue set carrying identifier, time and packet limits little endian. Statistics select receive and transmit basic, checksum, aggregation and rate plus control, each with a reply code. Device counters negotiate then use a stats get, else succeeding without exchange. Moderation uses global and per queue features with notify class sets. Guest offloads carry one 64 bit mask. Ethtool uses stats set, generic port, unknown markers, Toeplitz and poll weight.
